project.concept: A melancholic late-night vignette in a dim 1990s neon-lit bar: a 32-year-old East Asian man in a charcoal wool trench coat sits alone beside a rain-streaked window, performing the ballad entirely without lip-sync - his mouth stays closed and the emotion carries through posture, gaze, and breath. He reaches for a heavy faceted crystal rocks glass of amber whiskey, lifts it slowly toward his chest, pauses with a clenched jaw, and sets it back down without drinking as the condensation rolls down the glass.
project.visual_style: Cinematic 35mm film aesthetic: shallow depth of field, anamorphic blue-amber chromatic palette, rain-softened neon highlights, mahogany and cut-crystal specular detail, soft halation, and fine film grain.
project.primary_objective: Lock the trench-coated man, the faceted crystal whiskey glass, and the rainy neon bar across one H3 segment, keep every lip closed (no lip-sync), then mix the original track over the rendered footage.

segments.narrative_purpose: Carry the whole ballad in one continuous take: establish the man's isolation, then let the suppressed gesture of lifting the glass and putting it down without drinking carry the emotional turn. No lip-sync at any point.
segments.action: He sits beside the rain-streaked window, stares unfocused into the distant city lights, lowers his gaze, curls his fingers around the heavy crystal glass, lifts it two inches from the damp table, hesitates with a clenched jaw, and rests it back down without taking a sip.
segments.character_blocking: Seated at the window table, shoulders dropped, glass raised to chest height and lowered again, mouth closed throughout.

camera.notes: Two internal shots: a push-in on the still, closed-mouth face at the window, then a cut at 00:06.500 to a profile close-up of the hand on the glass.

segments.motion: Breath lightly fogging the cold glass; eyes hold unfocused on the rain; jaw clenches at the lift; the glass rises two inches, pauses, and returns to the wood.
segments.secondary_motion: Rain streams down the pane; neon reflections shimmer on the wet glass; condensation rolls down the outside of the rocks glass; a low hum sits under the room tone.

ref2va.detailed_description:
Cinematic 35mm film aesthetic, shallow depth of field, anamorphic blue-amber chromatic palette. No spoken dialogue; lips remain closed.
[Shot 1] The scene opens on <Subject 1> seated beside <Subject 2>'s wet glass window. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward <Subject 1>, who stares silently into the rain with heavy eyelids, his breath lightly fogging the cold glass.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a medium close-up profile. The camera tracks right with small amplitude at slow speed as <Subject 1> lowers his gaze, curls his fingers around the heavy crystal glass, lifts it two inches from the table, hesitates with tight jaw tension, and rests it back onto the damp wood without taking a sip.
ref2va.overall_soundscape: Low rumble of distant thunder, rhythmic rainfall pattering against glass, a subtle low-frequency hum of a neon transformer, and the sharp dull thud of a heavy glass touching wood.
ref2va.non_diegetic_music: A gentle, melancholic Mandarin vocal ballad supported by fingerpicked acoustic guitar and warm, lingering cello pads playing at 68 BPM.

assumptions_and_defaults: The creative ask was "no lipsync script", so the 1st AI Studio response was written as a silent-acting storyboard with no dialogue and closed lips.
The 1st response defines a single 12 s clip; the render uses 12.958 s (311 frames, a valid 5-mod-17 H3 length at 24 fps) so it covers the 13.032 s track.
Reference sheets are rendered at 1920x1080 (16:9, at least 2 MP); H3 crops them to its native portrait frame at render time.
The prop sheet is staged in the third reference slot; the model's ref2va prompt cites only <Picture 1> (character) and <Picture 2> (environment).
Audio trim uses start_index 0.0 s for the single segment, with the node's 20 s duration default.
The final audio is the original soundtrack only; the H3-generated vocal/foley layer is discarded (stitch_and_mix.py default).
The deliverable is the exact 9:16 pass at 1080x1920 (scale + center crop) alongside H3's native 768x1344 portrait master.
The character is named Wanderer for asset filenames; the 1st-response body itself calls him only 'the 32-year-old East Asian man'.
